messages:
hana: quick flag - onboarding sampleapp crashed in embed->rerank flow. Noticed after an auth refresh race we get mixed envelope shapes and null vector slots, causing index-mismatch when zipping scores.

kevin: can you paste SDK + a minimal payload?

hana: JS SDK v1.6.2, helper v0.9. Payload (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"open-embedding-small","inputs":["a","b","c"],"batcher":{"max_batch_size":8,"pad_to_max":true},"pipeline":["embed","rerank"]}
```

jamie: two recurring issues: (1) JS historically returned `vectors` vs other SDKs using `embeddings`; (2) pad sometimes inserted string "0" not numeric 0.0.

hana: raw response we saw: ```json
{"status":"ok","request_id":"r_ab12","vectors":[null,[0.11,0.02],[0.33,0.04]],"scores":[0.9,0.1,0.85],"candidates":[{"id":"a"},{"id":"b"},{"id":"c"}]}
```

kevin: if embeddings slot is null but scores dense, naive zip misassigns scores. ops logs show: 401 -> REFRESH -> immediate replay -> 429 -> collapsed batch with placeholders. helper replay has no jittered backoff.

jamie: proposed fixes: normalize JS SDK to `embeddings` (accept `vectors` for compat), ensure pad uses numeric 0.0, and add jittered exponential backoff to auth-replay. Also require length-check before zipping in helpers.

hana: short-term workaround: set `batcher.pad_to_max=false` and disable auto-replay in the client auth helper. slower but stable. adding a tiny repro to repos/sampleapp/examples/embed-rerank-repro and filing DEVEX-4444.

ops-bot: mitigation note: temporarily disable immediate replay for pipeline requests until SDK patch lands.

sdk-bot: plan: JS SDK v1.6.3 (patch) -> mapping + pad fix + tests -> canary 09:00 PT tomorrow.

kevin: assigning: jamie -> JS pad/name mapping + tests; hana -> sampleapp PR + repro. will follow up after canary. :thumbsup:
